about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Verdi was born from a simple idea: connecting people with quality, local food
about.story: We at Verdi understand that with work and all your obligations, you simply don't have time to go shopping, let alone to the farmers' market. That's why we come to you! Verdi delivers baskets full of healthy vegetables, directly from family farms near you — every 2 weeks, all year round!
about.missionText: We want your only worry to be... what to cook with all the wonderful, fresh, diverse ingredients that arrive at your door. Leave the rest to us!
about.partnersSubtitle: We work with 6 trusted family farms from the Zagreb area

betic.name: OPG Tomislav Betić
betic.desc: A family business with 31 years of tradition. A team of three members cultivates 6 ha and produces over 20 crops per year.

cabrajec.name: OPG Krešimir Čabrajec
cabrajec.desc: At Utrine market since its opening. Freshly harvested, unsprayed vegetables — 4 generations on the farm.

lackovic.name: OPG Lacković
lackovic.desc: Young agronomist Luka Lacković runs a 30 ha farm founded in 2009. Greenhouse and outdoor vegetable growing.

milicevic.name: OPG Miličević
milicevic.desc: 8 ha with a focus on sustainability and quality. Alongside vegetables, they produce cold-pressed juices from their own orchards.

novak.name: OPG Novak
novak.desc: Zagreb's largest organic vegetable farm. Over 50 tons of certified organic vegetables per year.

draganicki.name: OPG Draganički Plastenici
draganicki.desc: The Troha family, over 100 years in farming. Greenhouse and outdoor growing, own seedlings.
